_about: render/lookdev.py SPEC as glTF 2.0 PBR values (linear baseColorFactor; clearcoat = KHR_materials_clearcoat, transmissionFactor = KHR_materials_transmission, ior = KHR_materials_ior). three.js MeshPhysicalMaterial: color = baseColorFactor[:3] (linear), metalness, roughness, clearcoat, clearcoatRoughness, ior, transmission (+ opacity = baseColorFactor[3] for BLEND). Metallic paints: glTF has no F82 tint, so metallicFactor is lower than Blender's (blender_metallic) to keep grazing reflections from going chrome; the clear coat carries the gloss. specularFactor = KHR_materials_specular (F0 scale; low for the base layer under a clear coat and the anti-glare mask). Not representable in glTF: the paint flake normals, and the interior lining that lookdev.apply() puts on the BACK faces of the paint materials (three.js: side=DoubleSide + an onBeforeCompile gl_FrontFacing switch, or a lining mesh in the model).

_model.note: render-time changes in lookdev.apply() that belong in the model (model/assemble.py, model/livery.py); the viewer can mirror them

outline.rule: a ~8 mm paint_champagne stroke along every colour boundary of the white pinstripes / swooshes (livery strokes), photos 82 / 130 / 188

_model.paint_navy: livery stroke N1 is the base blue on MSN 3008 (no navy line): paint_navy == paint_blue
_model.back_faces: paint_* and trim_black / seal back faces render as the interior lining (LINING base [0.55, 0.55, 0.54], roughness 0.6; flight deck, model station x < 5.0 m: base [0.3, 0.3, 0.295]); exhaust_polished back faces: render_back_faces (soot)
_model.exhaust: the GLB 'black' primitives of exhaust_stacks (outlet band, inner wall, rim) render as exhaust_soot; exhaust_polished: render_collar (station-dependent heat tint and black outlet collar), render_polish (noise roughness / tint + bump)
_model.tyre_grooves: tire: the tread grooves are geometry in the GLB (model/wheels.py); no render_grooves (the render-time bump / viewer emulation would double them)
